propositions: Extract binding identity transition rules (bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, numeric-ID rekey) from BindingStore into a new BindingLifecycle slice while preserving all existing behaviors and keeping the public facade as coordinator.
Every valid bind/confirm/unbind transition must leave at most one forward entry and one matching reverse identity, with no ambiguity abort or sweep beyond the permitted targeted single-key pops.

Stale reverse entries are removed only in four permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind with differing jira_key, unbind with orphan sweep, rekey operation, and _retire; all other reverse-entry removals must abort.
Numeric-ID rekey transitions immutably re-key issues to new keys instead of retiring them, resetting absence_404_count and updating timestamps while preserving numeric_id unchanged.

The note_absent_or_rekey facade method remains the coordinator; only the rekey mutation (step 4: set jira_key, reset counters, swap indexes) moves to BindingLifecycle.rekey, which declines on missing or unchanged current key, leaving note_absent branches unchanged.
